question: When a production minister first works after it is made - the countdown its Enable sets, which reader B did not read.

addresses.name: CAIForeignMinister::Enable
addresses.comment: **Slot 52 of both CAIProductionMinister and CAIForeignMinister** - one body in both tables, named on the foreign minister; the production minister inherits nothing of it by RTTI but its slot holds the same address. `enabled (+0x3C) = 1`; appends a 0x10-byte node {this, prev, next, 0} to each of seven CAISubscriber channels in the block at 0x1B14F00..0x1B14F88 (VA; head, tail and count each); then `countdown (+0x30) = MT19937Next(&gamestate->+0x124) % 3 + 1` - one draw on the AI's generator, as CAITechMinister::Enable and CAIPoliticsMinister::Enable draw. So a production minister first works one to three AI passes after it is made, and every one made advances the generator once. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.1.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x89D360..0x89D5FA (VA): `mov byte [edi+0x3c],1` at 0x89D37E; seven node builds against the 0x1B14Fxx heads (35 references, 21 distinct addresses); `lea eax,[esi+0x124]; call 0xaa2b90; cdq; mov ecx,3; idiv ecx; inc edx; mov [edi+0x30],edx` at 0x89D5D3..0x89D5EA, then `ret`. vtable.py --holding 0x89D360: CAIForeignMinister slot 52 and CAIProductionMinister slot 52 (tables 0x15EB97C, 0x15EBD7C). Would be wrong if 0xAA2B90 were not MT19937Next - it is recorded so. Which channel is which notification was not read.
